## About
JC Wheels is a family-owned tire shop on Marbach Rd in San Antonio. We carry a big selection of OEM and take-off rims and tires, so you can upgrade your ride without paying for brand new.
One reviewer came in looking for an inexpensive way to upgrade their wheels and said we made sure they got what they wanted within their budget. Another said we don't try to upsell you. Customers rate us 4.9 from 176 Google reviews.

## Services
- Take-off wheels and tires: Take-off rims and tires, a budget-friendly way to change up the look of your truck or car.

## FAQ
Q: Do you carry take-off wheels and tires?
A: Yes. Take-off wheels and tires are what we're known for here in San Antonio.

Q: Are you open on Sunday?
A: No. We're open Monday through Saturday and closed on Sunday.
